queries.result: The search located the official Amhara National Regional State Bureau of Urban and Infrastructure page for Gonder City Administration and Ethiopia's official e-Land viewer. No Gonder-specific public parcel endpoint or downloadable safe parcel geometry was surfaced.

queries.result: The search found Ethiopian official land-registration/cadastre terminology and the national e-Land reference, but no Gonder-local public parcel map/API with anonymous safe geometry. The Amhara city page remained the strongest first-party Gonder-specific result.

freshResearch.method: Separate first-party discovery searches; anonymous read-only viewer/configuration inspection; no credentials, owner, address, titleholder, tax, account, or contact fields requested.

registryBasis: A city-specific custodial role is evidenced by the official Amhara urban/infrastructure page describing Gonder City Administration and its urban kebelles, but no Gonder-local cadastral registry endpoint or public parcel geometry was verified. National e-Land branding alone is not evidence of Gonder coverage.

officialSources.operator: Amhara National Regional State Bureau of Urban and Infrastructure / Gonder City Administration
officialSources.scope: First-party Gonder city profile; identifies city administration, service office, 12 sub-cities, 12 urban kebelles, 10 rural kebelles, and a structural plan. It does not publish parcel geometry or a cadastral API.

officialSources.operator: Land Holding Registration and Information Agency (e-Land viewer)
officialSources.scope: Official public land-holding registration viewer. The inspected page and JavaScript bundle exposed Addis-specific city configuration and corporate/e-services routes; no Gonder parcel layer was verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Gonder city administration and Amhara regional urban/infrastructure context are first-party evidenced; the national e-Land and NSDI portals are general national systems.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous source-native parcel polygon, stable parcel identity, CRS/schema response, or Gonder-specific public vector layer was verified.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No verified public Gonder parcel geometry and no independently qualified adapter. Packet completion is research completion only, not source integration/admission.

remainingUncertainty: Whether Gonder's city administration or Amhara land-registration custodian has a current public parcel service, and whether the unchanged WUP locator lies inside a published vector extent, remain unresolved. Viewer timeout and missing public configuration do not prove absence.
nextStep: Review official Amhara/Gonder or national e-Land service documentation for an advertised anonymous vector endpoint; qualify safe identifier-plus-geometry responses before any runtime admission.
